content.title: About
content.content: Whiskey and soda is a classic highball cocktail made with aged whiskey (usually bourbon or scotch) and carbonated water. It is served over ice and often garnished with a lemon or lime wedge. The soda softens the spirit’s bite, making the drink lighter and more refreshing.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The whiskey‑soda highball emerged in the United States in the early 1920s as a lighter alternative to neat whiskey.
Its popularity surged in the 1970s thanks to advertising campaigns that highlighted its low‑calorie appeal.
Carbonated water helps release the aromatic compounds of whiskey, especially fruity and spicy notes.
In some countries, such as Japan, a splash of ginger syrup is added for extra flavor.
The drink is traditionally served in a tall highball glass, emphasizing its refreshing character.

items.title: Moderate alcohol intake
items.content: Moderate consumption of whiskey (up to 30 ml per day for women and 45 ml for men) may help raise HDL‑cholesterol levels.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Whiskey contains polyphenols like ellagic acid, which have antioxidant properties.

items.title: Stress reduction
items.content: Small amounts of alcohol can promote relaxation and reduce stress after a long day.

items.title: Alcohol dependence
items.content: Regular alcohol consumption can lead to dependence and adverse health effects.

items.title: Liver impact
items.content: Excessive intake burdens the liver and may cause damage over time.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Alcohol can amplify the effects of certain medicines, so it should be limited or avoided when taking medication.

content.title: How to Drink
content.content: Pour 40–50 ml of whiskey into a highball glass, add ice, and top with carbonated water (about 150 ml). Optionally garnish with a lemon or lime wedge. Sip slowly and enjoy the aroma.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the whiskey bottle in a cool, dark place away from direct sunlight. Keep carbonated water in a sealed container in the refrigerator and use within a few days.
